verification_policy: Only entries with per-entry retrieved_utc fetched 2026-09-06 are verified-as-published (manufacturer / operator / RCDB page body observed). Wikipedia summaries, press-release mirrors, and prior numbers not observed on refetch are leads_only, status unverified, not primary evidence. Marketing record claims are labelled record-claim, distinct from measurement. This repo did NOT independently measure any spec. No peaks substitute for 10-s force exposure.
